highlights.title: New Paper Published in Journal of Climate
highlights.description: Our latest study on jet stream variability and its links to mid-latitude extremes is now available online.

highlights.title: PhD Student Wins Outstanding Poster Award
highlights.description: Congratulations to our graduate student for receiving recognition at the international climate dynamics workshop.

highlights.title: Lab Awarded New NSF Research Grant
highlights.description: Funding will support a three-year project on ocean–atmosphere coupling and decadal climate prediction.

highlights.title: Annual Lab Retreat Held in the Mountains
highlights.description: The team gathered for a two-day retreat to plan upcoming research directions and welcome new members.

highlights.title: Dr. Doe Delivers Keynote at International Climate Symposium
highlights.description: Dr. Doe presented recent findings on Arctic–midlatitude teleconnections to an audience of over 500 researchers.

highlights.title: Two New Postdoctoral Researchers Join the Lab
highlights.description: We are pleased to welcome Dr. Amara Osei and Dr. Wei Lin to the Climate Dynamics Lab team.
